data_description.stream_exit: Comma separated. A phrase must end on a word boundary, so that "bye" is not matched inside "byebye".
data_description.stream_exit_keys: Keys that close the assistant. On Technoline it has not yet been verified that the PBX forwards key presses to the streaming channel.
data_description.stream_return_path: A path in the extension tree, such as / or /2 — not an extension ID.
data_description.stream_tones: A short tone before the microphone opens, and one while the answer is being processed. Without them the caller cannot tell when to speak.
data_description.stream_rate: The streaming URL is not configured at Vonage — it is sent inside the NCCO during the call. Make sure the Event URL does not point at the Answer URL, or every status event is handled as a new call.

send_call.name: Voice alert
send_call.description: Calls the recipients and plays a message. The speech is generated in Home Assistant using the voice of the pipeline you selected. Use this service when the recipients change from alert to alert; for a fixed list you can also use assist_satellite.announce, which has no recipients field and always calls the numbers configured in the integration.
